transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I, uh... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work lately. I'm an electrician, and... I don't know, I just can't seem to focus on my estimates or the code forms anymore. It's like... if I hear a tool drop, or my phone buzzes with a text, or I just think of some new way to organize the workshop, I'm completely off track. And then... well, jobs are starting to get mixed up. So, yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're sitting still?

Yeah... I guess so. I just... sitting still feels like wasting time. So I don't really do it. 

I've been going pretty much nonstop lately. You know, from job sites to bids... rewiring test panels in the shop. I'll start messing with some new home-automation idea before the last one is even done. Just... staying busy, I guess.
Are you having problems with your relationships with family or friends because of your difficulty focusing or constant activity?

I mean... yeah. A bit. 

My wife and I have been arguing a lot lately. Just... about the mortgage, the business. She thinks I'm putting everything we built at risk. And, uh... work's not much better. Clients have started complaining about missed details and the schedules getting mixed up. Even my apprentices... I can tell they don't really trust my direction the way they used to. So... yeah.
Do you often feel guilty or blame yourself for the mistakes you've been making at work?
I don't know. I guess... I mean, I try not to dwell on it. It is what it is, you know? I just try to keep moving to the next thing.
Have you been making impulsive decisions lately, such as acting on ideas without thinking them through?
I mean... I don't really think so. I just... I get an idea and I want to see if it works. I don't know if that's impulsive. It's just... doing my job.
Do you have trouble focusing or feel restless at home or when you're not working, like when you're watching TV or trying to relax?
I don't really watch much TV. I just... I usually have a project going on in the garage, or I'm fixing something around the house. I don't really just sit around.
Do you have trouble focusing or feel restless when you're on vacation or taking a break from work?
I don't know. I don't really take a lot of vacations. When I get time off work, I'm usually just... doing other stuff. I guess I haven't really paid attention to it.
Do you feel restless or have trouble focusing when you're by yourself, without any work or projects to do?

I don't really know. I'm... I'm not usually just sitting around doing nothing. There's always something that needs fixing or... something to do. I don't really just sit by myself with nothing going on.
Do you feel restless or have trouble focusing when you're in a quiet, low-stimulation environment?

I'm not really sure what you mean by that. Like... a library or something? I just... I don't really spend time in quiet places. Job sites are loud, and I always have the radio on in the garage. So... I couldn't really tell you.
Have you ever started a new project without fully thinking through the potential consequences or costs?

I don't think so. I mean... I'm an electrician, so you kind of have to know what materials are gonna cost before you start a job. Even with my own stuff out in the garage, I... I usually know what I'm getting into. I don't really just jump into things blind, if that's what you mean.
Did you have symptoms of inattention, hyperactivity, or impulsivity when you were a child?
I don't really remember. That was a long time ago. I mean... I guess I was just a regular kid. I don't really recall having any major issues like that.
Did you have trouble paying attention or sitting still in school when you were a kid?
I don't know. I guess I was just a normal kid. I passed my classes, graduated... I didn't get in trouble or anything like that. So... no, not really.
Did your parents or teachers ever mention that you had trouble paying attention or sitting still when you were a kid?
I don't think so. My folks never... they never said anything about it. And teachers didn't call home or complain to them or anything. So, no.
Did you experience any symptoms like these when you were an adolescent?
Um... no. Not then either. Same as when I was younger, I guess. I just... kept my head down and got through high school. Nothing like that.
Did you have any problems with paying attention or behaving in class when you were in elementary school?
I mean, I think we already talked about this. No. I was just... normal. I didn't have any issues like that.
Did you experience any symptoms of inattention or hyperactivity before the age of 12?
Look, I... we just went over this. No. Nothing before I was 12, either. I didn't have those problems.
Have you experienced symptoms like difficulty focusing or feeling restless for most of your life?
I... feel like I keep saying the exact same thing here. No. Not my whole life. I didn't have those problems back then, so... no. I don't really know why we keep going in circles with this.
Have you had trouble focusing or felt restless in multiple areas of your life, such as at work, at home, and in social situations?
I... no. Not at work, not at home. I do my job fine. I really don't have this focusing issue you keep asking about.
Have you always had some level of difficulty with focus or restlessness, even if it wasn't as noticeable as it is now?
No. I... look, I just told you. I haven't always had those problems. I really don't know what else you want me to say here.
Have you experienced any periods in your adult life where you didn't have trouble focusing or feeling restless?
Yeah. All of it. I... I don't have those problems, so... yeah. All of my adult life. I really don't have anything else to say about it.
